buildCommand: if [ -f copy-deps.sh ]; then bash copy-deps.sh; else echo 'Script not found, trying alternative...'; cd .. && cp -r api idss_agent config data requirements.txt web/ 2>/dev/null || true; fi && npm install && npm run build
installCommand: npm install && (python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt -t . 2>&1 || python -m pip install -r requirements.txt -t . 2>&1 || echo 'Python dependencies install skipped - Vercel will handle automatically')
